text:
Spined predatory shield bug (Oechalia schellenbergii) -- a beneficial (predatory) insect.

Description: similar in size to the pest green stink bug (about 15 mm), but distinguished by spines on the shoulders (pronotum).

Role: an important natural predator that feeds on caterpillars of several pest species, including Heliothis/corn earworm (Helicoverpa) larvae, loopers, and armyworms -- worth recognising and conserving in the field as part of an IPM approach, since it can help suppress these pests naturally.
